```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("thief")
library(forecast)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoltr)
library(covidHubUtils)
```

```{r load in data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
func_list <- list.files(path = "../R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
lapply(func_list, source)

models <- c("THieF_4wk-4root", "THieF_4wk-noTrans",
            "THieF_8wk-4root", "THieF_8wk-noTrans",
            "THieF_12wk-4root", "THieF_12wk-noTrans")
for (i in 1:6) {
  load(file=paste("../data/", models[i], "/", models[i], ".RData", sep=""))
}

mon_fc_dates <- c(as.Date("2020-12-07") + weeks(0:29))

full_hosp_truth <- load_truth("HealthData", 
                         "inc hosp", 
                         temporal_resolution="daily",
                         data_location = "remote_hub_repo") %>%
                   arrange(location, target_end_date)
load(file="../data/versioned_truth_training.RData")

start_date = as.Date("2020-07-27"); end_date_ = as.Date("2021-01-03")
pi_levels = c(10 * (1:9), 95, 98)
```

```{r basic function testing, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
test <- 
  aggregate_thief_df(NULL, ts_col = "value", 
    start_date, end_date_, fips_code = "04", aggregate_levels = list(14, 7, 1), frequency = 14) 
plot_thief_agg(test, start_date)
temp <- compute_base_forecasts(test, pi_levels)
temp_reconciled <- reconcilethief(temp, aggregatelist = list(14, 7, 1)) # produces a warning

extended_test <- extended_truth_data(NULL, ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date_, fips_code = "04", aggregate_levels = list(14, 7, 1), frequency = 14)
dates_test <- get_ts_dates(start_date, end_date_, frequency = 14) 
plot_thief(base_forecasts= temp, reconciled_forecasts= temp_reconciled, ts_dates = dates_test, extended_truth = extended_test) 
trd <- transform_to_hub_df(temp_reconciled, end_date_, "04", pi_levels, h_ahead = 35)

hub_test <- thief_wrapper(NULL, ts_col = "value", 
  start_date, end_date_, fips_code = "04",
  aggregate_levels = list(14, 7, 1), frequency = 14,
  pi_levels = pi_levels,
  plot.aggregates = TRUE, plot.forecasts = TRUE)
```

```{r}
truth_comparison_04_210104 <- full_hosp_truth %>%
  filter(target_end_date >= as.Date("2020-07-27"),
        target_end_date <= as.Date("2021-01-02"),
        location == "04") %>%
  arrange(target_end_date) %>%
  rename(revised_value = "value") %>%
  select(1, 3, 4, 6:7, 5) %>%
  cbind(select(filter(training_truth_list[[5]], location == "04"), value)) %>%
  mutate(difference=value-revised_value) %>%
  filter(difference != 0)

filter(training_truth_list[[5]], location == "04") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=target_end_date, y=value)) +
  geom_point(color="blue") + geom_line(color="blue") +
  geom_point(data=filter(full_hosp_truth, 
                          target_end_date <= as.Date("2021-01-02"),
                          target_end_date >=as.Date("2020-07-27"),
                          location == "04"), 
            aes(x=target_end_date, y=value)) +
  geom_line(data=filter(full_hosp_truth, 
                          target_end_date <= as.Date("2021-01-02"),
                          target_end_date >=as.Date("2020-07-27"),
                          location == "04"), 
            aes(x=target_end_date, y=value))

aggregate_04_210104 <- training_truth_list[[5]] %>%
  aggregate_thief_df(
    start_date=as.Date("2020-07-27"), end_date=as.Date("2021-01-04"),
    fips_code="04", transform.4root=FALSE)

plot_thief_agg(aggregate_04_210104, as.Date("2020-07-27"))
  
training_truth_summary <- c()
for (i in 1:30) {
  temp <- training_truth_list[[i]] %>%
    group_by(location) %>%
    summarize(total_days = n()) %>%
    arrange(total_days) %>%
    mutate(expected_days=mon_fc_dates[i]-as.Date("2020-07-27") - 1)
  
  training_truth_summary <- rbind(training_truth_summary, temp)
}
# US and Louisiana (22) are missing truth data (8/19-9/2) for the first 4 weeks of the training phase
  


```

```{r}
start_date = as.Date("2020-07-27"); end_date = as.Date("2021-01-29")

base_fc_no_04_210104 <- modfc_8wk_noTrans %>%
  filter(location == "04", forecast_date == as.Date("2021-01-04")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(base_fc_obj)
rec_fc_no_04_210104 <- modfc_8wk_noTrans %>%
  filter(location == "04", forecast_date == as.Date("2021-01-04")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(rec_fc_obj)

dates_test <- get_ts_dates(start_date, end_date-2, frequency = 56) 
plot_thief(base_forecasts= rec_fc_no_04_210104, reconciled_forecasts= rec_fc_no_04_210104, ts_dates = dates_test, agg.names = agg.names) 

test <- 
  aggregate_thief_df(
    training_truth_list[[5]], ts_col = "value", 
    start_date, end_date, fips_code = "04", 
    aggregate_levels = list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1), frequency = 56, transform.4root = TRUE) 
plot_thief_agg(test, start_date)
temp <- compute_base_forecasts(test, pi_levels)
temp_reconciled <- reconcilethief(temp, aggregatelist = list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1)) # produces a warning
plot_thief(base_forecasts= temp, reconciled_forecasts= temp_reconciled, ts_dates = dates_test, agg.names = agg.names) 
temp_rec_df <- transform_to_hub_df(temp_reconciled, end_date, "04", pi_levels, transform.4root = TRUE)

temp_reconciled2 <- transform_forecasts(forecasts=temp)
temp_rec_df2 <- transform_to_hub_df(temp_reconciled2, end_date-2, "04", pi_levels, FALSE)
temp_rec_df1 <- thd(temp_reconciled, end_date-2, "04", pi_levels, TRUE)

  
thief_wrapper(NULL, ts_col = "value", 
  start_date, end_date, fips_code = "US",
  aggregate_levels = list(14, 7, 1), frequency = 14,
  pi_levels = pi_levels,
  plot.aggregates = TRUE, plot.forecasts = TRUE)
```

```{r turn stored model info into forecast csv's}
plot_thief(base_fc_no_04_210104, rec_fc_no_04_210104, dates_test)
rec_fc_no_04_210104 %>% transform_to_hub_df(end_date-1, "04", pi_levels, FALSE)

load(paste("../data/", models[3], "/", models[3], "2.RData", sep=""))
sun_fc_dates <- c(as.Date("2020-12-06") + weeks(0:29))
fips_vec <- filter(hub_locations, geo_type == "state", population >= 500000) %>% pull(fips)

thief_df <- map_dfr(
  .x = fips_vec,
  .f = function(fips_code) {
    modfc_8wk_4root %>%
      filter(location == fips_code, # will have to iterate through locations
            forecast_date == sun_fc_dates[27]) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      pull(rec_fc_obj) %>%
      #as.list() %>%
      transform_to_hub_df(sun_fc_dates[27]-1, fips_code, pi_levels, TRUE)
  }
)

write_csv(thief_df, file=paste("../data/", models[3], "/", mon_fc_dates[27], "-", models[3], ".csv", sep=""))
```

```{r sarima covid fc}
end_date <- end_date_
ts <- get_truth_ts(df = sun_training_truth_list[[5]], ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date, fips_code = "04", frequency = 7, transform.4root = FALSE)
base_forecasts <- forecast(auto.arima(ts), h=45, level = pi_levels)
extended_truth <- suppressWarnings(get_truth_ts(df=sun_training_truth_list[[5]], ts_col="value", start_date, end_date + 45, fips_code = "04", frequency = 7))
ts_dates <- get_ts_dates(start_date, end_date, frequency=7)

plot(base_forecasts, shadecols = c("light gray", "#EEC2C2", "#900000"),
    xaxt = "n", #axes = FALSE,
    ylim = c(0, max(base_forecasts$x, base_forecasts$upper)))
lines(base_forecasts$mean, col="red", lwd=2) # plots red base forecasts line
if(!is.null(extended_truth)) lines(extended_truth, col='black', lwd=1.5, lty = "dotted") # plots extended truth data against forecasts
#axis(1, at=1:(periods + 1), labels = ts_dates) # changes axis labels to provided dates
axis(2)

hub_df <- transform_to_hub_df(base_forecasts, end_date-1, fips_code="04", pi_levels, 35, FALSE)


fi <- sarima_wrapper(df = sun_training_truth_list[[5]], ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date, fips_code = "04", frequency = 1, pi_levels, plot.forecasts = TRUE, transform.4root = FALSE)
fc_info <- sarima_wrapper(df = sun_training_truth_list[[5]], ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date, fips_code = "04", frequency = 7, pi_levels, plot.forecasts = TRUE, transform.4root = FALSE)
```
